tesis: Human will is entirely determined by external factors and internal inclinations, leaving no room for genuine freedom.
tesis_es: La voluntad humana está completamente determinada por factores externos e inclinaciones internas, sin dejar espacio para una libertad genuina.
nucleo: whether human will is genuinely free or entirely determined.

tesis: Human will is inherently inclined towards good and can act independently of external influences.
tesis_es: La voluntad humana está inherentemente inclinada hacia el bien y puede actuar independientemente de influencias externas.
nucleo: whether human will is inherently inclined towards good and independent of external influences.

tesis: Self-love can never be the sole motive of virtuous actions.
tesis_es: El amor propio nunca puede ser el único motivo de acciones virtuosas.
nucleo: whether self-love can be the sole motive of virtuous actions.

tesis: The principle of approbation is fundamentally derived from self-love rather than an inherent moral sense.
tesis_es: El principio de aprobación se deriva fundamentalmente del amor propio en lugar de un sentido moral inherente.
nucleo: whether the principle of approbation stems from self-love or an inherent moral sense.

tesis: The ultimate moral principle is derived from human rationality and not from divine authority.
tesis_es: El principio moral ultimate se deriva de la racionalidad humana y no de la autoridad divina.
nucleo: whether the ultimate moral principle is grounded in human rationality or divine authority.

tesis: Moral goodness is primarily determined by the inherent nature of actions rather than their consequences.
tesis_es: La bondad moral se determina principalmente por la naturaleza inherente de las acciones, no por sus consecuencias.
nucleo: whether moral goodness is based on the inherent nature of actions or their consequences.

tesis: Prudence is more dependent on moral virtues than on intellectual virtues.
tesis_es: La prudencia depende más de las virtudes morales que de las virtudes intelectuales.
nucleo: whether prudence relies more on moral virtues or intellectual virtues.

tesis: The highest good in life is the pursuit of pleasure.
tesis_es: El bien más alto en la vida es la búsqueda del placer.
nucleo: whether the highest good in life is the pursuit of pleasure

tesis: Virtue can be taught through ethical discourses and preaching.
tesis_es: La virtud puede ser enseñada a través de discursos éticos y predicaciones.
nucleo: whether virtue can be taught through abstract knowledge and discourses.

tesis: The principle of utility is the sole criterion for moral action.
tesis_es: El principio de utilidad es el único criterio para la acción moral.
nucleo: whether the principle of utility alone determines moral action

tesis: True relief can only be found through divine intervention.
tesis_es: El verdadero descanso solo se puede encontrar a través de la intervención divina.
nucleo: whether true relief is solely attainable through divine intervention.

tesis: Altruistic behavior is inherently motivated by a natural human desire to alleviate suffering rather than by calculated self-interest.
tesis_es: El comportamiento altruista está motivado inherentemente por el deseo natural humano de aliviar el sufrimiento, más que por el interés calculado en sí mismo.
nucleo: whether altruistic behavior stems from a natural desire to alleviate suffering or from calculated self-interest.
